title: Self-Determining
summary: SELF-DETERM'INING, adjective. Determining by or of itself; determining or deciding without extraneous power or influence; As the self-determining power of the will.

inlines.v: SELF-DETERM'INING, adjective. Determining by or of itself; determining or deciding without extraneous power or influence; As the self-determining power of the will.
